title: Cheap Totems
description: Yet another craftable totem mod... But wait! This one's cheap! And it comes with an advancement!
body:
Yet another craftable totem mod... but wait! This one's cheap! And it comes with an advancement!
Craft one with just 1 emerald in the middle surrounded by 8 gold ingots in a crafting table.
There's also an advancement titled "I'm not dying today!"

Get it today! Now for 1.21.8 Fabric & NeoForge!
